task: Task 19 / S5 — multi-intervention counterfactual defense lab
headline: COUNTERFACTUAL MODEL SIMULATION

disclaimers.causal: These trajectories are model-based what-if projections. They do not estimate causal real-world defense effectiveness because the World Model was not trained on intervention/outcome data.
disclaimers.direction: Different scenarios may produce higher or lower projected threat probabilities. This reflects the frozen model's response to the simulated state perturbation and should not be interpreted as proof that a defense would help or harm in reality.

substrate.sweep_rule: fixed stride 7, no randomness, no label involvement (the same stride S4 used)

scenarios.description: The observed window is rolled forward through the frozen V4 model with no perturbation of any kind. This is the frozen forecast every other page of the console shows, and it is the reference every scenario delta is measured against.

scenario_matrix_note: descriptive only. No overall score and no ranking is emitted, and no direction is called successful: 'lower' and 'higher' describe the frozen model's projected probability, not real-world risk.

progression_change_display.progression_disappears: Projected progression disappears under this scenario
progression_change_display.progression_appears: Projected progression appears under this scenario
progression_change_display.progression_shifts_later: Projected progression shifts later under this scenario
progression_change_display.progression_shifts_earlier: Projected progression shifts earlier under this scenario
progression_change_display.progression_target_stage_changed: Same projected timing, different projected next stage
progression_change_display.no_progression_identified: No progression identified in either scenario

A_elevated_threat.selection_basis: highest NO_ACTION max-forecast probability among the swept sequences; ties broken by lowest sequence_id

B_forward_progression.selection_basis: lowest sequence_id among swept sequences whose NO_ACTION Task-16 status is FORWARD_PROGRESSION_IDENTIFIED

C_scenarios_diverge.selection_basis: largest spread across scenarios of the projected max-forecast probability, max(scenario) - min(scenario). Direction-agnostic: it measures how much the scenarios DISAGREE, not which way any of them moves

D_unreliable_or_caution.selection_basis: lowest sequence_id among swept sequences whose NO_ACTION Task-15 status is UNRELIABLE; if none, the lowest whose status is CAUTION

E_progression_change.selection_basis: lowest sequence_id among swept sequences where at least one scenario's categorical progression-change outcome is not 'same_progression' and not 'no_progression_identified'

F_progression_timing_shift.selection_basis: lowest sequence_id among swept sequences where at least one scenario shifts the estimated time-to-progression. Direction-agnostic: 'shifts later' and 'shifts earlier' are both admitted, so the rule cannot prefer the flattering direction

E_no_action_vs_screening_predictions.note: documented CPU-vs-MPS device gap, same as Tasks 12 / 15 / 18

what_this_is_not: not proof that an intervention would work in reality
limitations: No output of this layer is a causal effect. The model was never trained on interventions, so its response to a state perturbation is a property of the model, not of a defense.
Only the FINAL observed timestep is perturbed, because earlier timesteps are observed history. The V4 encoder is an LSTM over ten windows, so projected changes are small by construction.
Projected changes are heterogeneous in sign across sequences. A lower projection is not mitigation and a higher projection is not evidence that defending would be harmful.

Interventions modify only features whose transformation follows from the frozen contract; plausible real consequences the contract cannot determine are deliberately not modelled, so every perturbation is incomplete by design.
RESTRICT_EGRESS assumes blocked destinations carry a proportional share of window volume — a first-order assumption, not a measured property.
Only two interventions are defensible on the frozen 26-feature contract; see third_intervention_audit.
The scenario matrix is descriptive. It carries no overall score and no ranking, because the model cannot support one.
